name: Intercontinental Los Angeles Downtown
positioning: InterContinental Los Angeles Downtown: a skyscraper hotel on the upper floors of the Wilshire Grand Center, with a 70th-floor lobby and skyline views in the Financial District
best_for: Travelers who want to see Los Angeles from high above the city
Visitors to the Convention Center, Crypto.com Arena or Peacock Theatre who want to walk there

facts.text: A high-speed elevator takes guests to the hotel's 70th-floor lobby.
The hotel occupies the upper 36 floors of the Wilshire Grand Center, which opened in 2017.
Guest rooms span from the 31st to the 66th floor.
Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with skyline views.
One-bedroom suites have a separate living room, a powder room and a soaking tub.
La Boucherie serves steak and seafood with panoramic skyline views.
The heated outdoor rooftop pool is on the 7th floor, with a hot tub and a bar.
The pool area has a separate children's area.
The fitness center's locker rooms have saunas and steam rooms.
The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 70th floor and overlooks downtown Los Angeles.
The hotel is in the Financial District, a fifteen-minute walk from Crypto.com Arena, Peacock Theatre and the Los Angeles Convention Center.
The hotel is in the first LEED Gold-certified building in Downtown LA.

highlights.text: Spire 73 is the tallest open-air bar in the Western Hemisphere.
The 7th-floor pool deck is deliberately retro, with blue lane dividers and underwater lights.
The Presidential Suite has a grand piano.
Club InterContinental guests can check in privately at the Club InterContinental Lounge.

considerations.text: Pets are welcome only if they are under 40 pounds.
WhataHotel notes city noise considerations that come with the urban location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the downtown luxury positioning.
